result.reason: The clause does not reach even the fallback because indemnification obligations remain capped. It also retains the express exclusion for loss of or damage to records or data, which may defeat the intended data-protection/security carve-out; the phrase “foregoing limits and exclusions” does not clearly override an exclusion appearing later. The preferred $1 million floor, IP-infringement carve-out, and payment-obligations clarification are also absent. The revision is limited and otherwise preserves the existing allocation, but its placement and scope are ambiguous.
